headline: S&P 500 Futures Rise Slightly Following Recent Tech Sell-Off
summary: S&P 500 futures edged up on Sunday night as investors brace for continued market volatility following a recent technology sector sell-off.
why: Stock index futures are derivative contracts that allow investors to trade index values outside of regular market hours, serving as a key indicator of market sentiment ahead of the opening bell.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Futures contracts rose slightly during Sunday night trading sessions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Futures rose slightly as investors reacted to a prior tech sell-off and positioned themselves for ongoing market volatility.
